evaluation.replica_interpretation: Deterministic nominal repeatability copies, not40 independent randomized starts.
evaluation.survival: All40 complete20 seconds for a full-survival result; post-failure physical samples remain in RMSE.

time_axis.definition: Retrospective TensorBoard logged iteration wall timestamp minus original process start; includes preceding online-evaluation time. NOT the original online result availability time and NOT a new prospective time-to-threshold measurement.
time_axis.source_tag: Loss/qf_loss for original FastSAC; iteration for model-based runs.
time_axis.initialization_rows: No retrospective logged timestamp exists at iteration0; CSV field blank and these four points omitted on time-axis plots. They remain at measured0 real transitions on sample-axis plots.

resolution_and_interpretation.checkpoint_resolution: 250 saved learner iterations/loop indices; iteration work differs across algorithms. CSV retains exact recorded real simulator transition counters.
resolution_and_interpretation.transition_axis: Actual saved-checkpoint counts on shared axes; not a fabricated exactly matched sample grid.
resolution_and_interpretation.thresholds: First sampled strict pass; no interpolation, monotonicity assumption, confidence interval or multi-seed superiority claim.
resolution_and_interpretation.line_segments: Visual connections between measured checkpoint samples only; never used to infer an exact crossing.
resolution_and_interpretation.scope: One-seed laptop experiment comparing complete method recipes. Integration/normalization/compilation differences prevent isolating all effects to the world model.

csv_field_mapping.pass: aggregate XY/yaw thresholds plus full survival
csv_field_mapping.all_command_pass: Each command individually meets both thresholds plus full survival
